_comments.development: true while building/testing; set to false before scheduling in prod -- turns off fast-iteration shortcuts like skipping cluster restarts between runs
_comments.continuous: false = triggered (Lesson 53) -- runs once per trigger, then stops. Set true only for a genuinely low-latency streaming need; triggered is the right default for a nightly bronze-to-gold batch.
_comments.edition: ADVANCED unlocks expectations (@dlt.expect*) used throughout this pipeline's silver_trips definition -- CORE does not support them
_comments.pipelines.reset.allowFullRefresh: false prevents an accidental full table rebuild from wiping gold's history -- mirrors Lesson 51's table_properties example
_comments.libraries: one notebook per @dlt.table/@dlt.view module -- Lakeflow infers the bronze -> silver -> gold dependency graph from the dlt.read()/dlt.read_stream() calls inside them, not from this list's order
